name: Highlights
description: A headline and two or three short cards over your photo: what you offer, why people choose you, or what is new. For a service, opening hours or a quick list.

eyebrow.label: Label
eyebrow.description: A short label above the headline, e.g. WHY LOCALS CHOOSE US. Leave empty for none.

headline.label: Headline
headline.description: The big statement. Use | to break the line, e.g. YOUR LOCAL|ACCOUNTANT.

headline_accent.label: Accent words
headline_accent.description: Words of the headline shown in your brand colour, exactly as they appear in it. Leave empty for none.

card_1_title.label: Card 1 title
card_1_title.description: A few words, e.g. Fixed fees.

card_1_text.label: Card 1 text
card_1_text.description: One line, e.g. One price, agreed up front. Leave empty for none.

card_2_title.label: Card 2 title
card_2_title.description: A few words, e.g. Tax return ready.

card_2_text.label: Card 2 text
card_2_text.description: One line. Leave empty for none.

card_3_title.label: Card 3 title
card_3_title.description: A third card. Leave it and its text empty for two cards.

card_3_text.label: Card 3 text
card_3_text.description: One line. Leave empty for none.

cta.label: Button
cta.description: The button's words, e.g. Book now. Leave empty for none.

handle.label: Handle
handle.description: Your account handle, top right, e.g. @yourbrand. Leave empty for none.

photo.label: Photo
photo.description: The photo behind the words: a person, a place or a product, with no words in it. Upload one, pick one from the Library, or let AI make one. Without it, your brand colours show.

sample_data.headline: YOUR LOCAL|ACCOUNTANT.
sample_data.card_2_text: Filed before the deadline, every year.
